spec.title: Longhorn volumes
spec.description: Longhorn volume health and replica placement

spec.expr: (longhorn_replica_state == 1) * on(volume) group_left(pvc, pvc_namespace, volume_status) label_replace((max by (volume, pvc, pvc_namespace, state) (longhorn_volume_robustness) == 1), "volume_status", "$1", "state", "(.*)")
